shorts.hook: Point a thermal camera at a polar bear and it almost disappears.
shorts.outro: Doug's camera worked perfectly. What was still glowing on that screen a second later is in the full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT WAS LEFT GLOWING ON THE SCREEN?

shorts.outro: So Doug dressed as a seal and lay on a floe edge, right where the bear comes up. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: DID THE BEAR MISS DOUG TOO?

shorts.hook: Canada has a jail for polar bears. Nobody feeds the prisoners.
shorts.outro: Doug took the rubbish out in that same town. There was a bear in the stairwell. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHO WAS WAITING IN THE STAIRWELL?
